//: Typechecks the shipped connector packages and their tests.
Separate from examples/tsconfig.json because these moved out of examples/ when
connectors became a top level directory. A package that nothing typechecks is a
package whose contract handshake fails at API boot instead of at build time.
Modules here reach across into apps/api by relative path — the tests drive the
real executor — so the program is rooted at the repo root rather than at
No DOM lib, deliberately: a connector package declares its own ConnectorContext
structurally and depends on nothing, and keeping that honest is what caught
apps/api naming the ambient RequestInfo global in a module examples had to import.
